title: Family Law Attorneys in Denver County

content.rendered:
Family Law Attorneys in Denver County

Get the help you need!

Call (303) 261-8111

Your divorce, your custody arrangement, your financial future — when all of it is in motion at once, the attorney you hire needs to know where your case will actually be heard.

The Drake Law Firm serves Denver County from our Lakewood office, minutes west of the city on Colfax. We appear in Denver District Court and bring practical, courthouse-level knowledge to every case we file there. Denver has no shortage of family law attorneys. What it has less of is a firm that tells you the truth about your case from day one and keeps the conflict where it needs to be — no higher.

Schedule a Consultation

Call for immediate assistance: (303) 261-8111  |  Book online

What We Handle

We represent individuals and families throughout Denver County in the following matters:

  • Divorce — contested and uncontested, including high-conflict and high-asset cases.
  • Child Custody (Parental Responsibilities) — parenting time, decision-making, and modification disputes.
  • Child Support — initial orders, modifications, and enforcement.
  • Spousal Maintenance — including temporary and long-term support disputes.
  • Property Division — real estate, retirement accounts, business interests, and debt.
  • Prenuptial and Postnuptial Agreements — drafting and review.
  • Paternity — establishing and challenging parental rights.
  • Modifications and Post-Decree — parenting plan changes, support modifications, and enforcement.

Our Offices and the Courts We Serve

We serve Denver County clients from our Lakewood office on West Colfax — a direct shot from most Denver neighborhoods. We do not have a Denver County office. What we have is a team that appears in Denver District Court and understands what that court expects.

Capitol Hill, Congress Park, Washington Park, Platt Park, Highlands, LoHi, Baker, Overland, Stapleton / Central Park, Montbello, Green Valley Ranch, Five Points, RiNo, Park Hill, University Hills, Harvey Park, Sunnyside, Virginia Village, University Park, Hampden

Adjacent Areas

Jefferson County (our home county), Arapahoe County, Adams County. If you are unsure whether your case falls within our service area, call and ask.

Why Denver County Families Choose The Drake Law Firm

We know this courthouse.

Denver District Court is a high-volume court with its own procedural rhythms — specific expectations around financial disclosures, parenting plan formats, and docket scheduling. Our attorneys appear there and understand what it takes to move a case efficiently through the Denver system.

You’re not paying for downtown overhead.

Our Lakewood office is minutes from Denver with none of the premium real estate costs built into hourly rates. We are accessible from anywhere in the city and honest about what your case will cost.

No Drama is a real standard.

We push for efficient, cooperative resolution when it is available. When it isn’t, we go to hearing prepared and don’t blink. Both are true at the same time.

We tell you what you need to hear.

Not what you want to hear. Every case starts with an honest assessment of where you stand and what your realistic options are. We don’t run up the clock on false hope.

Results that reflect it.

Law Firm 500 ranked The Drake Law Firm #32 nationally in 2024 with 310% growth. Saturday appointments and Zoom consultations are available. We work with your schedule.

What to Expect When You Call

Reaching out to a family law firm is not a small thing. Here is what happens when you contact us:

  •  Your first call. Someone on our team will listen to your situation, answer your initial questions, and help determine whether your matter is the right fit for our practice.

  • Free 15-minute consultation. You will speak with an attorney about the specifics of your case, understand your options, and get a straight answer about what lies ahead.

  • A clear path forward. If we are the right fit, we will outline a strategy built around your goals and the realities of Denver County’s court system.

Ready to talk? Schedule your consultation or call (303) 261-8111 for immediate assistance.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which courthouse will my family law case be filed in?

If you live in Denver County, your case will be filed at Denver District Court at 1437 Bannock St in Denver. The 2nd Judicial District handles all district court matters for Denver County, including divorce, parental responsibilities, and adoption proceedings.

Do I need to come into an office, or can we meet virtually?

Both options are available. Our Lakewood office is on West Colfax, accessible from Denver in under 20 minutes from most central neighborhoods. Phone and Zoom consultations are also available, including Saturday appointments, for clients who prefer remote access or cannot take time off during the week.

How long will my divorce or custody case take in Denver County?

Colorado requires a minimum 91-day waiting period from the date of service before a divorce decree can be entered. Beyond that, timelines depend on whether the case is contested, the complexity of the assets or parenting issues involved, and Denver District Court’s current docket. We will give you a realistic timeline during your consultation based on the specifics of your situation.

What does it cost to hire The Drake Law Firm?

The Drake Law Firm operates on hourly billing. Costs depend on the complexity and duration of your matter. We discuss fees transparently during your consultation so there are no surprises.

I am not sure what kind of help I need yet. Can I still call?

Yes. That is exactly what the consultation is for. You don’t need to have everything figured out before you reach out. Call, describe your situation, and we will help you understand your options.

Start With a Conversation

Whatever your family is facing in Denver County, the path forward starts with a single conversation. Schedule your free 15-minute consultation with The Drake Law Firm. We will listen, tell you the truth, and if we are the right fit, we will go to work.
